children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on Travere Therapeutics's stock with a price target of $67.00.
The price target implies an upside of 6.6% from the Sep 21 close of $62.86.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: The appointment of Bradley L. Campbell, a seasoned leader with over 25 years of biopharma experience, is expected to bring valuable expertise to Travere Therapeutics. His proven track record in commercial growth and rare disease management aligns well with the company's strategic goals as it advances its pipeline.

: HC Wainwright & Co. maintains a positive outlook on Travere's continued execution of its product FILSPARI and the advancement of its pipeline candidates. This reflects the firm's belief in the company's ability to deliver effective therapies for rare diseases, reinforcing their Buy rating.
